name: The Memory Tailors
prompt: String a single line of black velvet booths beneath a translucent lilac ribbon cable. Technicians fit embroidered memory cuffs to customers' sleeves. One cuff unspools a bright geometric memory above a tailor's open palm.

name: The Rain Cache
prompt: Fill a narrow cross-shaped alley with shallow dark catch basins. Data carried in luminous green raindrops accumulates in rings on their surfaces. Under tiny umbrella hoods, vendors skim the rings onto clear discs before they fade.

name: A Neuron Repair Café
prompt: Slice a pale silicone brain into a series of standing lobes. Tea stalls occupy the gaps; customers sit beneath pink neural threads while repairers splice dim strands into bright ones. A single thread crosses the street to a waiting bicycle.

name: The Dream Vending Wall
prompt: Build a freestanding wall of translucent square drawers, each holding a gently glowing jellylike miniature landscape. Visitors exchange their sleeping dreams at a low counter. One empty drawer projects a rectangular shaft of yellow light through the wall.

name: The Haptic Arcade
prompt: Stretch enormous bands of ridged black rubber between staggered red poles. Shoppers wearing fingertip readers walk the bands to sample borrowed sensations. Clothespins mark spots worth returning to, their clusters revealing the most popular memories.
